ITEM 1 | Dark green fresh leaves, flat and wilted-looking, with thin pale stems, piled in a loose mound at upper left of plate, some leaves glossy and slightly moist, a few small orange/yellow shredded pieces scattered among them, covering roughly 12% of plate area, about 3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Golden-orange shredded strips (small matchstick-like bits) scattered over the leafy greens, slightly glossy, possibly coated with dressing, about 0.5 cm wide and 2-3 cm long, sparse, covering about 2% of plate | 8
ITEM 3 | Triangular wedge of baked, golden-brown crust with browned, bubbly, slightly raised surface and pale melted-looking topping over a red-tinged layer, sitting at upper right edge, about 8 cm by 5 cm footprint, about 2 cm thick, firm and holding its shape, covering roughly 8% of plate | 75
ITEM 4 | Roasted orange-red chunks with darker caramelized edges and slight sheen, irregular pieces about 2-3 cm across, arranged in a cluster at right edge beside the wedge, firm, covering roughly 7% of plate, about 1.5 cm tall | 50
ITEM 5 | Pale green sliced zucchini rounds and half-moons with bright green skin and light flesh, some with darker grill-like browned edges, slices about 0.8-1 cm thick and 4-6 cm across, moist and firm, arranged in a fan at lower right, covering roughly 14% of plate | 90
ITEM 6 | Bright green broccoli florets, small clustered heads about 2-3 cm across with slightly darker tips, firm and moist, scattered among the zucchini at lower right, covering roughly 5% of plate, about 2 cm tall | 35
ITEM 7 | Pale yellow-green slices of summer squash with a pale, slightly translucent surface and faint browning, about 1 cm thick, interleaved with zucchini at the right side, covering roughly 4% of plate | 30
